conversion.versions: gold identities start at declared version 1, not measured runtime versions

summary.interval_note: Wilson intervals describe unique questions within each repetition. Queries within a session can still be dependent. Paired differences resample whole sessions, retaining all queries and repetitions.
summary.state_pair_note: Fixed-query variants are baseline controls. Source-wording variants preserve different query texts and may change embeddings. All three strategies ignore declared state labels; neither comparison establishes state-module effectiveness.

stored_vector_audit.note: SQLite backup page hashes differ from the owning database file; this check compares exact vector values and float32 index bytes.
